title: tools: ase2bn.py, Aseprite indexed -> Butano graphics/*.bmp + .json (tags, durations, palette check)
acceptance: One command converts projects/<x>/art/*.aseprite to graphics/; used by compilar.bat and the template; never overwrites .aseprite; tested on the hello project with a screenshot

title: tools: itch_pack.py, release kit for GBA (EmulatorJS pinned + mGBA core, ROM zip, notices, itch limits)
acceptance: One command builds <GAME>_WEB.zip and <GAME>.zip for any project; SHA-256 of vendor tarballs checked; index.html at root; web build boots the hello ROM in a local browser check

title: harness: set .claude/worktree.json junctions/base_paths for the final repo layout and test worktree.py add/remove on a dummy branch
acceptance: Sparse add of the hello project builds its ROM inside the worktree; junctions only to untracked dirs (toolchain/devkitPro ...); remove refuses dirty/unmerged and leaves the main checkout identical (file counts of junction targets before/after)
